image_description: A vintage-style agricultural scene featuring a man in a blue shirt and white headband operating a two-wheeled walk-behind tractor (power tiller) equipped with a plow attachment. The machine is actively tilling dark, clumpy soil in a field of dry grass. The plow assembly includes a curved moldboard and a cutting share digging into the earth. The tractor has large, treaded rear wheels and smaller front stabilizer wheels.
